answer: Under Section 317(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, a person who dishonestly receives or retains any stolen property, knowing or having reason to believe it to be stolen, is subject to punishment. The penalty can include imprisonment for up to three years, a fine, or both. This applies specifically to individuals who knowingly buy stolen property.
summary_answer: A person who knowingly buys stolen property may be charged under Section 317(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, for dishonestly receiving or retaining stolen property.

final_answer: A person knowingly buying stolen property may be charged under Section 317(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
